anomalies.description: A man with long hair aims two handguns directly at the camera; muzzle flash is visible in frame f3 (13.5s), confirming discharge.
A man grabs a woman from behind, lifts her off the ground, and struggles with her while she holds a gun; this is mutual physical combat involving grappling and weapon control.

After the struggle, the woman is seen lying motionless on the ground (f12–f14), while the man looms over her aggressively (f15), indicating she is helpless and being attacked or subdued post-combat.; After the initial struggle, one individual is subdued and lying prone on the ground while the other stands over them, holding the gun; the victim appears helpless and is being threatened or attacked.; A person is repeatedly attacked while lying helpless on the ground; the attacker holds a gun to the victim's head and chest across multiple frames, constituting sustained abuse of a defenseless individual.
A handgun is fired at point-blank range, producing a visible muzzle flash and smoke cloud that engulfs the target lying on the ground.

A person in dark clothing is seen holding a handgun to the head of a prone, helpless victim lying on the ground; the attacker then presses the gun into the victim's neck/chest area while the victim appears restrained and unable to resist.
The victim is shown with fresh blood erupting from the neck and face, consistent with a close-range gunshot wound; the gun remains in contact or very near the wound site at the moment of impact.

After the shooting, the attacker (partially visible) remains over the injured victim, who is now sitting up, gasping and clutching her chest/neck in distress, indicating continued threat or post-assault control.
